rules.requirement: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.

assertingTests.name: an Innkeeper-protected Zombuul does not spend its first death (BMR-INNKEEPER-01)
an Innkeeper prevents the Pukka's delayed death and clears the poison (BMR-INNKEEPER-01)
a multi-target night step rejects the same player twice (BMR-INNKEEPER-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01, BMR-PO-01)
the Innkeeper's two players are safe tonight, one is drunk until dusk and the next choice ends them (BMR-INNKEEPER-01)
a healthy Innkeeper makes both players safe tonight and one drunk until dusk (BMR-INNKEEPER-01)
a poisoned Sailor or Innkeeper gives no effect and still ends the last choice (BMR-SAILOR-01, BMR-INNKEEPER-01)
